result.headline: Five Tools for Working with AI: Beyond Better Wording
result.opening: A request can sound better without becoming better justified. AI can improve the wording while leaving the reason for the request unexamined.
result.body: That gap is the starting point for this essay: improving how a request is expressed does not establish whether it is justified. This is a practitioner methodology, not a scientifically validated result.
result.promise: The focus is a practical distinction: the quality of the wording and the justification for the request are separate questions.
result.payoff: A polished request still needs scrutiny of what it asks and why.
result.call_to_action: Consider your next AI-assisted request: has its wording improved, and have you checked its justification? Use that distinction if it helps, ask for clarification, or challenge it.
